mentions.name: Carolina Cloud
mentions.description: Carolina Cloud is a cloud hosting service being migrated from a custom-built orchestrator to Kubernetes to gain pod movement flexibility and KubeVirt live migration capabilities. The migration will enable draining nodes one by one and relocating them to a cheaper second colocation site in South Carolina, moving away from the current colocation facility.
mentions.problem: The custom orchestrator built for the service lacked the freedom of pod movement and live migration capabilities needed to relocate infrastructure between colocation facilities.
mentions.source_excerpt: Currently moving Carolina Cloud to Kubernetes. I had built a custom orchestrator but really want the freedom of pod movement as well as KubeVirt's live migration capabilities. My ultimate plan is to open a second location in South Carolina at a cheaper colocation and then drain the nodes one by one, moving them to there, and leave my prior colocation.
